protocol.nightly_rhr: Mean HR, file-local 00:00–06:59, current and preceding ten minute step bins all explicitly zero; >=60 distinct qualifying HR minutes. Missing steps are not zero.
protocol.duplicates: Floor timestamps to minute; duplicate HR averaged, duplicate steps max; invalid numeric/timestamps excluded. No overnight or detector imputation.
protocol.cases: Table 3 Category exactly COVID-19, first listed valid symptom timestamp (original cell order, not sorted). Other dates are not searched for better performance.
protocol.case_baseline: First 14 calendar nights starting at first HR record date, including partial/missing nights; >=10 plausible RHR nights; final baseline date <= onset minus seven days. No later-window search.
protocol.control_baseline: Participants whose base ID appears in neither Table 3 nor Table 4; first 14 plausible valid nightly RHR values; evaluate only after the last selected baseline date.
protocol.identity: Match base participant ID before any underscore; repeated illness files are excluded from controls together. Standard *_hr.csv files only; *_longterm files not added as independent participants.
protocol.detector: Unchanged frozen M3; median / max(1.4826*MAD,1.5 bpm) fixed baseline; lambda .2, control_sigma 3 (EWMA threshold 1); unknown nights reset state. No symptoms, HRV or temperature inferred.
protocol.primary: Any watch in inclusive relative days -7..+7; first watch within that window; by-onset metric uses the same window through day 0. A watch may be ongoing from before the window.
protocol.false_alerts: Contiguous watch episodes on calendar nights after baseline and before day -7 for cases, all post-baseline for controls; unknown breaks an episode. Denominator: valid/evaluable person-nights; no-reported-illness does not mean confirmed healthy.

bootstrap.interval: percentile 95%; summed event/exposure ratio for false alerts
